description: Regional-class incident train (1.2 m, T=1000 s, 1 wave) prescribed at the west edge from t=0; crosses the deep basin, shoals over the 25 km shelf, reaches the coast (~t 1900 s).

grid.origin: domain centered on (0,0); cell (j,i) center at (xmin + i*dx, ymin + j*dx)

physics.scheme: MUSCL minmod theta=1.3, HLL, SSP-RK2, well-balanced, wet/dry; see solver_cpu_hll.py (reference) and swe_hll_step.frag

sampling_rule: a snapshot is the state at the FIRST substep whose cumulative t >= t_requested; exporters and the browser test must both follow it
